summary: Robin Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, attaching a press release providing a fleet commercial update for May 2026. The update covers two LPG carriers under time charters generating $713,000 aggregate monthly revenue, notes the sale of M/T Wonder Mimosa in April 2026 with a ~$6.7 million gain, and reaffirms contracted revenue exceeding $8.4 million for 2026. No merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine operational update for a foreign private issuer. The filing does not trigger a special-situation classification.
